en: A black‑and‑white panoramic postcard view of the city center of Graz, showing ornate baroque and historicist buildings along a main street, with several church towers and clocktowers. In the background on a steep hill stands the prominent clock tower of the Schlossberg overlooking the city. The caption at the top identifies the scene as Graz and names the street and hill. At the bottom left is the photographer's or publisher's credit with the year 1920.
